review.reason: The tensorflow-cpu/TensorFlow 2.21.0 pip path still reaches libclang>=13.0.0. The selected libclang 18.1.1 package now has exact package/release/upstream-source/build-recipe lineage, but its selected Windows/Linux wheels were uploaded to PyPI with twine rather than Trusted Publishing, no GitHub Actions release runs survive for the exact packaging commit, and the Linux packaging recipe used an unpinned manylinux2010_x86_64:latest build image. Under the existing fail-closed bar, exact wheel-to-build attestation and the exact applicable native third-party notice set therefore remain unresolved. Do not bypass pip metadata, use --no-deps, or weaken provenance/redistribution requirements. Stop this pip runtime hypothesis and move to a distinct official-source conversion path.

next_distinct_candidate.name: TensorFlow 2.21.0 source-native TOCO command-line converter
next_distinct_candidate.capability_from_exact_source: The exact TensorFlow 2.21.0 source defines a public native toco CLI backed by toco_tooling, TensorFlow graph import, and TFLite export. The exact-source README states that the TensorFlow Lite Converter accepts frozen TensorFlow graphs and generates TensorFlow Lite FlatBuffer files.
next_distinct_candidate.why_it_is_distinct: This route does not depend on installing the tensorflow-cpu Python wheel or satisfying its libclang Python-distribution dependency. It is an official TensorFlow source target rather than a repackaged third-party wheel.
